name: Aggregated Penalty Amount 2
definition: Specifies the aggregated penalties amounts per party.

PartyIdentification.name: Party Identification
PartyIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of the party for which the aggregated amounts are referred to.

AggregatedDebitAmount.name: Aggregated Debit Amount
AggregatedDebitAmount.definition: Sum of the debit amounts for the party.

AggregatedCreditAmount.name: Aggregated Credit Amount
AggregatedCreditAmount.definition: Sum of the credit amounts for the party.

GlobalNetAmount.name: Global Net Amount
GlobalNetAmount.definition: Net of all amounts for this CSD.
